༄༅/ /bde mchog bcu gsum ma bzhugs/sgrib bral lhan skyes bde ba'i ye shes nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rnam par rol pa can/ /dpal ldan he ru ka

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog bcu gsum ma bzhugs/sgrib bral lhan skyes bde ba'i ye shes nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rnam par rol pa can/ /dpal ldan he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas la/ btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /

de la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs nyams su len bde ba zhig bshad par bya ste/ spyir bde mchog gi sgrub thabs la lha re gnyis ma/ lha bcu gsum ma/ lha lnga ma/ dpa' bo gcig/'khor lo gsum gyi lha so sor dbye ba'i dbang du byas pa'i sgrub thabs sogs mang du bshad cing*/ khyad par lha bcu gsum ma la rgya gzhung gi sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus mang du snang ba las 'dir 'bring bo'i dbang du byas na/ bde mchog gi dbang bskur thob pa zhig gis/ gnas yid dang mthun par 'di'i bris skud dang mchod gtor sogs ci 'byor sta gon byas te/ skyabs sems ni/ mchog gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /he ru ka dpal yam yum la/ /skyabs min sems can don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi byang chub sems bskyed do/ / de nas rdor sems kyi bsgoms bzlas rgyas pa 'dod na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar/ bsdus pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdor sems he ru dkar bo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs ka'i zla gdan la hūm̐ yig gi mthar yi ge brgya ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par gyur par bsam la/ he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig gam bdun bzla/ de nas bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ / zhes sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /dag pa gsum ni/ 'di'i gzhung 'ga' zhig tu mi snang yang*/ byas na legs pas de'i tshul ni / shrī he ru ka he ni kun gyis 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i sems te rgyu'i bdag nyid du brtag par byas pa'i stong ba'i chos kyi bdag med pa dang*/

rgyu ni gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi dra bas bkod pa'i gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ ka ni de kho na nyid yul yul can gnyis mi mthun par so sor mi gnas pa dang*/ shrī ni yul stong ba nyid ji 'dra ba de bzhin du rjes su zhugs pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes e waṃ gyi don no/ / stong ba'i ngang las skad cig gis rang nyid he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ shrī he ru ka3haṃ/ lan gsum/ de nas oṃ a ā nas kṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ rang gi lte bar dbyangs gsal gyi 'phreng ba lan gsum gyis bskor ba las he ru ka'i lha tshogs 'phros pa sna bug g.yas pa nas 'thon bgegs thams cad bskrad*/ slar byon sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs te lte ba'i sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ de nas sems can thams cad bdag dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig thob zin pa'i bde ba brtan par gyur cig yid de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gnas par gyur cig / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs kar padma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po/ de'i 'od zer gyis rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gdabs thog ma med pa nas kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma rnams sbyangs/ lus shel gong ltar dag par gyur te/ ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ gang gi drin gyi bde chen gnas/ zhes sogs tshogs bcad gcig gi mthar/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo tshe/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyis/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/

/gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing/ /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ tsakra saṃ ba ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ nas sha pta'i bar dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gam/ bsdu na/ oṃ āḥbadzra ā darshe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra wi ni hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra ghandhe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra rā sa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra sparshe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra dharme hūm̐/ de nas rkang brgyad kyis bstod pas mchod dam min yang rung*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs 'chi/ / zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi snying kar thim par byin gyis brlab par gyur bar bsam mo/ /'di'i rgya gzhung ba la cher las mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas bskyed pa mi snang yang*/ bskyed na ni lags pas de la 'chi ba chos sku'i lam khyer ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas shūngngho3haṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te 'od kyi rnam par gyur pa rang la thim/ rang yang stod smad nas rim gyis hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas/ nā da'i bar rim gyis thim zhing*/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya ta nas ko3haṃ/ bar longs sku'i lam khyer ni/ stong ba'i ngang las rang sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du bsgreng zhing phra ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar du sngags de nyid kha dog nag po/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang khu/ oṃ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub tu sngags de nyid kha dog dmar bo/ /oṃ ā na ya ho bai rya rā dzā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lhor sngags de nyid kha dog ser bo rnams su 'khod par gyur/ de rnams las rang 'dra'i kha dog can gyi 'od zer tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab pa'i 'od zer chen po'i gzugs rnams su gyur/

sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las shar nag /byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i ra ba gru bzhi ba tshad de lta bu/ ra ba grub pa dang mnyam du 'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje gzhi/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur/ gur gyi 'od ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re/ de'i phyi rol tu mda'i dra ba rdo rje'i ra gur rnams bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i me 'jig dus kyi me lta bus bskor bar gyur/ oṃ me de nī badzra bha wa badzra bhandha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra prā kar hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pañtsa ra hūm̐ pa hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lā rka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ su mbha ni sogs bzhi brjod de/ /'gro ba rnams rnam pa thams cad du bgegs dang bral bar gyur bar bsam mo/ /srung 'khor gyi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu rgyal mtshan gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar bo gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar bo zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor sar bo gru bzhi ba rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab gru bzhi ba lcogs brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du baṃ la sna tshogs padma/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du baṃ las sna tshogs padma chung ngu'i dbus mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo a āḥnas aṃ āḥste dbyangs yig dkar bo bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yon skor dang*/ slar yang a āḥnas aṃ ā ste dbyangs yig dkar bo bcu drug phrag gcig g.yon skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyi rol dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo ka kha ga gha nga nas/

sha ṣa sa ha kṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig g.yas skor dang*/ slar yang ka kha ga gha nga nas/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig g.yon skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyi rol dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo ka kha ga gha nga nas sha ṣa sa ha kṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig g.yas skor dang*/ slar yang ka kha ga gha nga nas sha ṣa sa ha kṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig g.yon skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de gnyis yongs su gyur ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar la mdangs can la dbyangs gsal gnyis gzugs brnyan bzhin du shar ba'i ā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba'i cha ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ kā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dmar ba'i cha ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang sems nam mkha'i nā das zla ba dkar dmar mthong nas de'i dbus su zhugs pas/ slar yang nā da nas ū'i bar rim pa bzhin du hūm̐ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin can du rdzogs par gyur pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ hūm̐ yi ge nā da las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne las he ru ka'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas 'gro ba rnams he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ thog ma nas grub pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig spyan drangs snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas zhu bas hūm̐ yig la thim pas hūm̐ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi nī ka yawā ka tsitta badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badzra shūngnghaḥsarba dharmā:badzra shūngngho3haṃ/ zla ba dbyangs gsal hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /rten gyi gzhal yas khang de yang gru bzhi ba/

sgo bzhi ba phyin nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdug gis mdzes par phug pa/ rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'i nang gi shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser bu sngo ba/ pha gu'i steng na gser gi ska rags bzhi/ phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas rin po che'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed la dril bu dang rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab las dpyangs pa'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng du mda' yab padma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa mdzes par byas shing*/ steng gi zur bzhir gdugs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i mtha' nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar bos bskor ba la bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo 'khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang 'og gi phyi nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rin chen gyis sbras/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun ru ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs gser la sogs pa'i snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum bzang bo las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang*/ sprin gyi gser nas byung ba'i lha me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i rab me ri dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad na shing brgyad/ de la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad dang zhing skyong brgyad/ chu brgyad dang der gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ srin brgyad/ ri brgyad/

mchod rten brgyad/ me brgyad/ gzhan yang keng rus dang gsal shing las bskyon pa dang*/ khwa dang 'ug pa dang bya rgod la sogs pa dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po dang grub pa thob pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dur khrod rnams kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ /zhal bzhi ba'i rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yon zhal ljang*/ rgyab zhal dmar/ g.yas zhal ser/ zhal re re yang spyan gsum pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ dbu re re la'ang thod pa bskam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ dbu yi g.yon du cung zad yo ba'i zla ba phyed pa 'chang ba/ dpral bar rdo rje rtse lnga ba'i 'phreng 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi ba'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis ḍa ma ru dang ral gri 'dzin pa'i mgo bo mnan cing*/ g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo lag bzhi ba'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing*/ lhag ma gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa'i nu ma mnan pa/ gdan gnyis ka'ang gdong gcig pa mig gsum pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /phyag bcu gnyis pa'i gdong gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang bo che'i lpags pa rlon pa sdig mdzub dang bcas pas brkyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi ba na dgra sta/ lnga ba na gri gug/ drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa bsgreng ba/ g.yon pa'i gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga/bzhi ba na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ /lnga ba na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi ba bsnams shing*/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa sogs pa'i nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thab can/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcus phreng ba byas pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/

/bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ /zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ gcer mo skra krol ba/ thod pa dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og bag can/ phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa'i thod pa na bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gi gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yas pas gdug pa can kun la gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla yi steng na legs par 'khril ba/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo bskam po lnga'i thod bskams lnga bcu'i do shal can no/ /phyogs bzhir 'dab ma la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ /byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro he dmar mo/ /lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ /mtshams bzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ shar sgor khā gdong ma nag mo/ / byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljag khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ /lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ /shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang*/ byang shar gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal can/ gcer mo skra krol ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa bzung nas thugs kar 'khyud pa'i tshul mdzad cing*/ g.yas 'og mas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon 'og mas kha ṭwāṃ ka 'dzin pa/ thod bskam snga'i dbu brgyan cing*/ thod bskam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ro'i gdan dang*/ thams cad kyang nyi gdan la g.yas brkyangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ dkar bo las rdo rje dkar bo rtse lnga ba bhra dmar bo las byung ba'i nor bu dmar bo byā ser bos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas ā dmar bo las padma dmar bo 'dab ma gsum pa dha dkar po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i lte ba dkar bo dyā ser bos mtshan pa/

yab kyi lte bar zla gdan la oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nā ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ thugs kar zla gdan la oṃ sarba bungngha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warsha nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mgrin par nyi gdan la oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzwa la saṃ bha raṃ swā hā/ dpral bar nyi gdan la oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi lte bar nyi gdan la shrī badzra sogs dang*/ thugs kar nyi gdan la oṃ hrīḥha sogs dang*/ mgrin par zla gdan la oṃ badzra bai ro sogs dang*/ dpral bar zla gdan la oṃ sarba bungngha sogs sngar bzhin no/ /sngags rnams kha dog dmar bo/ g.yon skor du phan tshun zhal sbyor bar gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badzra hai hi ru ru gaṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems spyi bo nas zhu ba mgrin par slebs pa na dga' ba/ snying khar slebs pa na mchog dga'/ lte bar slebs pa na khyad dga'/ nor bu'i rtser slebs pa na lhan skyes kyi dga' ba skyes/ bde bas stong ba nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med du sbyar bas/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka /yab yum dang*/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi dang*/ yang dag pa'i las gyi mtha' sogs bzhi dang*/ yang dag spong ba bzhi ni sgo mtshams ma brgyad de thams cad kyang bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes ngo bo nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bur 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ go cha ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar bo/ /mgo bor rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser bo/ /spyi gtsug tu padma gar dbang gi ngo bo swāhā hu dmar bo/ /phrag pa gnyis su he ru ka'i ngo bo phaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser/ dpral bar nyi ma la rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang khu/ yum gyi lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar bo/

/snying gar nyi ma la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yaṃ sngon po/ /mgrin par zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ maṃ dkar bo/ /mgo bo nyi ma la skyod byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ hriṃ ho dmar ser/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byaid ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ dpral par nyi ma tsiṇḍi ka'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa duḥkhas mtshan pa/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/

de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ pheṃ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i bde mchog lha bcu gsum pa'i ye shes pa'i 'khor lo dang dbang gi lha rnams oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ oṃ arghaṃ pratī tstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dag gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pe ra yo gi ni kā ya wa ka tsitta badzra swā bhā wa adma ko3haṃ/ oṃ lo ga shungnghaḥsarba dha rmāḥyo ga shungngho3haṃ/ de nas dbang lha la/ oṃ arghaṃ nas swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyi rdo rje glu len/ gtso bo dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum dang lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas shrī ye hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag /chu'i lag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur ba las/ yab la rdor sems dang yum la mi bskyod pa/ snying bo'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rnam snang don grub 'od dpag med rin 'byung dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum mam/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ chu gsum dang bcas pa'i mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ khaṇḍa ro his bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las kaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyis nang du hūm̐ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las dbang bo drug gi spyod yul du bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ shrīḥhe ru ka sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūm̐ swā hā nas shapta'

ི bar dang*/ sngar ltar rig ma drug gam/ bcu drug gis kyang mchod du rung ngo*/ /nang mchod ni/ mchod do/ /sku bzh-i'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi=/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i=/ grub chen lū dril nag gsum gyi=/ chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha chen po'i=/ mkhas grub ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyi=/ rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgya mtsho'i=/ bde mchog brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur zhes sogs kyi 'jug tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥha sogs dang*/ badzra bai ro tsa na'i bar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyar ba/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sogs snying bo'i rnal 'byor ba bzh-i sngags kyi mthar dang*/ oṃ kā ka sya huṃ hūm̐ zhes sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad po'i sngags kyi mthar ye ge gsum sbyar ba dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥmṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bhā wa adma ko ྅haṃ/ mgron rnams bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ de nas/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs yab dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma sogs yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bston cing*/ spro na/ ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ zhes sogs sam/ yang na/ rab mdzes ind+ra nī la'i lhun po la/ /byu ru'i 'khri shing mchog gis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /zag med bde la rtag rol he ru ka / yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ zhes bstod/ de nas phreng ba bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las phreng ba skad cig gis padma gar gyi dbang phyug tu gyur pa 'od du zhu ba las bgrang phreng gi nam par gyur pa'am/ yang na gzhung ltar bskyed de/ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las lha'i tshogs spros/

'gro ba'i don byas nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur bar bsams la/ yab yum gnyis kyi/ snying bo nye snying ci 'grub/ oṃ ḍā ki nāe ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ru pi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā ka sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ u lū ka sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shū ka ra sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā+-i ḍha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū te huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣti ṇi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnams ci 'grub bzla'o/ 'di skor gyi brgya gzhung phal cher las yab yum gyi rtsa sngags bzla bar ma bshad pas de gnyis ma bzlas na chan lhag tu mi 'gyur yang*/ bzlas kyang phun sum tshogs pa las mi rung ba mi snang ngo*/ /mthar he ru ka'i yig brgya brjod de/ nyer bsdu bya ba las slar mchod pa'i tshul mi 'byung ngo*/ /nyer bsdu ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pa gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas/ de rnams 'od kyis snang bar byas/ dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ de sgo mtshams ma brgyad la thim/ de rnal 'byor ma bzhi la thim/ de gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la thim/ yum dang rang stod smad nas rim gyis zhu ste snying ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar rim gyis thim zhing*/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i yab yum kyi skur bzhengs ba'i thugs kar zla ba rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar bo zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ gtor ma byin brlab dang 'bul tshul rgyas pa ni lha mang nyung gi khyad par ma gtogs lha snga ma ltar bya ba yin la/ bsdu na/ byin rlabs gong ltar ram/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/

stong ba'i ngang las yaṃ yas rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar bo/ /de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang gi shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir g.yon skor ba dbus su oṃ khaṃ aṃ traṃ hūm̐ las rim pa bzhin du dri chen sha chen byang sems rakta dri chu rnams yi ge de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du laṃ yaṃ paṃ tāṃ las rim pa bzhin du ba lang khyi glang chen rta'i sha rnams ni slar yang yi ge de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos me 'bar ba'i drod kyi rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu nas bdud rtsi dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las kha ṭwāṃ ka dkar bo mgo thur blta ba thod par lhung ste zhu bas bcud de dag dngul chu'i mdog can du gyur/ /de rnams kyi steng du dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge de rnams yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams bkug ste yi ge gsum la thim zhing*/ de gsum yang zhu nas bdud rtsir thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ pheṃḥ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong sogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas sha pta'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas kyi ljags huṃ dkar bo las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar bo nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra a ra li hoḥ

badzra ḍā ki n+yas ma la stāṃ tri shya hoḥ zhes pa lan lngas gtso bo sogs la phul nas/ nang mchod sngar bzhin mchod/ de nas yab kyi rkang rgyad dkyis bstod pa'am/ sngar bzhin bstod cing*/ srid pa dang mnyam zhes sogs kyi 'dod yon la gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas phyogs skyong sogs skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las bde mchog gi lha yab yum gyi skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags zhes sogs sngar ltar byin byis brlabs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes sogs lan gnyis kyis phul nas/ phyi nang mchod pa phul te/ bstan pa srung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ / zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol zhing*/ mthar yid brgya bzlas nas/ ma rnyed ces sogs kyis bzod gsol byas la/ badzra muḥ'ajig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs shing*/ ye shes pa bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shungnghoḥ shungngho3haṃ/ de nas srid pa gsum 'bar sogs dang*/ lha mo mtshan ma sogs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis sogs kyi smon lam dang*/ gshis brjod kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /bde mchog rtsa bshad rgyud 'grel gyi/ /rgya mtshor rnam dpyod srub shing gis/ /legs par bsrubs las sgrub thabs kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i snying bo 'di ko bskrun/ /dge des tshe rabs kun du bdag /he ru ka dpal yab yum dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub med can gyis bde mchog gi lam 'dir mos kyang*/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa ma lcogs pa'i dad ldan don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la phan par bsam te co ne dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs 'od zer ro/ /sarba madga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bde mchog bcu gsum ma bzhugs/ - PAGE 102-- PAGE 113-- PAGE 99-
